title: Gulfview Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Gulfview is a modern home with a recent WOW renovation featuring all new bathrooms, kitchen, with designer furnishings and touches throughout. Just 4 houses to the beach and 1 block to downtown Seaside!
description_expanded: Description30 WEST RUSKIN STREET2 Kings, 1 Queen, Bunkroom (3 twins, and one queen), Bonus day bed - Sleeps 12New Renovations Winter 2026! Will Sleep 12 with two king suites and a new bunk bedroom! Several updates throughout the home. New images to come Mid May 2026. Welcome to Gulfview | A Newly Renovated Seaside RetreatWelcome to Gulfview, a beautifully renovated coastal cottage in the heart of Seaside, Florida—new to the rental market and thoughtfully designed for modern beach living. Located on West Ruskin Street just four houses from the beach, this inviting home offers a prime location paired with serene outdoor spaces and stylish interiors, creating the perfect setting for a relaxing Seaside getaway.Outdoor Living & ArrivalGuests arrive to a private driveway with parking for two cars and are welcomed by an open-air front porch furnished with lounge seating and Adirondack chairs for four. This breezy porch is an ideal spot for morning coffee or winding down after a day at the beach. A screened-in back porch on the first floor provides additional outdoor dining and seating, offering multiple spaces to enjoy Seaside’s coastal atmosphere.First-Floor Living & KitchenInside, Gulfview features an open-concept layout with designer furnishings and a fully renovated kitchen. The spacious living area includes a large sectional sofa, two club chairs, and a mounted flat-screen TV—perfect for movie nights or family gatherings. Just beyond, the dining table comfortably seats eight and flows seamlessly into the modern kitchen.The kitchen is outfitted with crisp white cabinetry, stone countertops, a center island with bar seating for four, pendant lighting, stainless-steel appliances, a double-door refrigerator, and a separate beverage and wine fridge. A convenient half bath and laundry closet with a full-size stackable washer and dryer complete the main living level.Also located on the first floor is a queen guest bedroom with a private ensuite bath featuring a marble single vanity, generous storage, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Second-Floor Bedrooms & Bonus Living SpaceThe second floor hosts three additional bedrooms and a secondary living area. A queen bedroom features custom built-in wardrobe closets and direct balcony access. The primary king suite includes ample closet storage, new furnishings, front balcony access, and a private marble bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower.A cozy bonus living space with a daybed and large flat-screen TV serves as a perfect hangout for kids or teens. The fourth bedroom, located at the rear of the home, offers comfortable accommodations with ample storage. A shared full bathroom with a tub and shower combination serves the queen and twin-bed bedrooms.The highlight of the second floor is the expansive open-air balcony, furnished with lounge seating and a chaise lounger overlooking peaceful treetop views.Tower Level & Sunset ViewsAt the top of the home, a glass-enclosed third-floor tower provides a unique retreat with bar-top seating for four and additional club chairs. Step out onto the Juliette balcony to take in panoramic views of Seaside, glimpses of the Gulf, and unforgettable sunsets—a true signature feature of this coastal cottage.Prime Seaside LocationGulfview offers luxury, comfort, and an unbeatable location—just steps from the sugar-white sands of Seaside and one block from Central Square. With its thoughtful design, multiple outdoor spaces, and proximity to Seaside’s shops, dining, and beaches, Gulfview is an exceptional choice for your next 30A escape.* 5-night minimum in Spring Break & Summer; 3-night minimum for Spring & Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registrationPlease note: There is nearby construction that may impact your stay. For more information, feel free to contact us directly.FEATURES2,048 square feetSeaside Private Beach access at the West Ruskin PavilionExclusive access to Seaside, the largest private residential beach on 30A151 feet / 1-minute walk to beach accessPeacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels, sheets, and coverlets throughout the homeAccess to resort-style amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes (a golf cart is considered a vehicle; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit)No pets allowedSTR23-002049
